text:
sara_cs: FYI ticket ST-34567 from AcmePayments. After yesterday's deploy (v3.2.1) their invoice-summary responses started inserting vendor fees and nonexistent promo codes — customer says this did not happen on the prior model.

acme_support: Example: we POST invoices to /summarize and previously got clean line items. Now the model returns extra lines like `Processor fee: 2.3% (PayFlux)` and `Promo applied: SAVE10` which never existed on the invoice. This is causing accounting mismatch.

sara_cs: Pasting a minimal repro (sanitized) and actual model reply below.

sara_cs: ```
POST /v1/summarize
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-1001",
  "lines": [
    {"desc": "Consulting services", "amount": 1200.00},
    {"desc": "Cloud hosting", "amount": 340.00}
  ],
  "customer": "AcmePayments"
}
```

sara_cs: Model response we received: ```
Invoice Summary for INV-1001:
- Consulting services: $1200.00
- Cloud hosting: $340.00
- Processor fee: 2.3% (PayFlux) - $34.84
- Promo applied: SAVE10 - discount $154.40
Total: $1420.44
Note: Promotional code SAVE10 automatically applied per merchant agreement.
```

mike_eng: Can you confirm which catalog model and routing are being used? Any recent routing overrides or inference config changes?

sara_cs: Customer on hosted endpoint, model id reported as `redwood-v3-gen-2b` route had `fastpath=true`. They say this started right after our 2024-11-02 runtime deploy.

jules_research: This looks like the model is hallucinating assertive, extraneous billing items. Could be a behavior shift from the new assertiveness tuning or a prompt pipeline preprocessor that augments billing details. Need request IDs + model variant snapshot + kernel/quant flag.

sara_cs: Provided request_ids: 7890abc, 7890abd, 7890abe (attached logs).

lee_oncall: Checking runtime: I see a config change rolled yesterday: `billing-augment=enabled` rolled in commit 4d2b3f. Also see deploy note from ops to enable a new prompt normalizer. Rolling back that change for the customer's route now as a mitigation.

opsbot: Rollback initiated for customer routing rule redwood-v3-gen-2b@2024-11-02-09:12:37 (trigger: lee_oncall).

mike_eng: I repro locally with the same payload and model variant; with `billing-augment=enabled` the model tends to invent fees. With it disabled, output matches previous behavior. I suspect preprocess plugin is inserting contextual tokens that prompt the model to be assertive about fees.

jules_research: Immediate asks for CS to collect 5 diverse examples with request IDs and indicate whether temperature or top_p changed. Also we need the exact model artifact hash and whether int8 quant was used. We'll run the hallucination detector suite and compare to baseline v3.1.

sara_cs: Customer is upset and paused calls. They want either rollback to prior model or an emergency fallback. Estimated impact: high for billing integrity customers.

mike_eng: Created infra ticket INF-8723 and assigned to eng-ml. Attaching initial triage notes and the suspected commit (4d2b3f) that enabled `billing-augment`.

jules_research: Suggest short-term mitigation: 1) disable billing-augment on hosted fastpath, 2) add post-response sanity checks for invoice outputs, 3) schedule a targeted eval to measure invented-entity rate across recent deploy.

sara_cs: Will send rollback confirmation to customer and collect the 5 examples. Updating ticket ST-34567 and pinging account team.

acme_support: Thanks — please confirm ETA for rollback and whether we can get a formal incident report for our audit team.

lee_oncall: ETA rollback complete in ~10 minutes (already started). We'll follow up with timeline and postmortem. :alarm:
